prespecification:
Prespecified 2026-11-15T02:06Z, before any launch of this batch (operator: Claude Opus 5.5, claude-opus-5-5).
Authorised by the project lead through the coordinator. Headline hosted runs on task version 2 (instructions v3).

Dataset: suite/clinical-v1@2 (tag instr2, digest f7d7cd08f525), all 5 tasks:
  reg-resect-build-0001 seg-spleen-build-0001 measure-hc18-0001 ecg-ptbxl-superdiag-0001 risk-icu-mortality-0001
  Oracle on this version: run 15fc4349-028e-42dc-982f-feccff226b7c reproduced every oracle_expected_reward.
Agent: claude_code_noweb-v1.0.0 as installed (downloaded 02:05Z, byte-identical to agents/claude_code_noweb/;
  --disallowedTools "WebFetch WebSearch", --max-budget-usd 8 per task, setup pins Claude Code 2.1.325).
Effort: the contract's only parameter is `model`; run_cmd passes only {model}; collect_outputs passes no --effort.
  So "effort high" is NOT accepted by this agent and the Claude Code 2.1.325 default effort applies. Recorded from traces.
Runs (one attempt per task each, launched together, nothing else):
  A: --agent claude_code_noweb-v1.0.0 --dataset suite/clinical-v1@instr2 --provider modal --model anthropic/claude-opus-5-5
     -s ANTHROPIC_API_KEY anthropic-api-key --concurrency 3 -l hosted-agents2-opus
  B: same with --model anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5 -l hosted-agents2-sonnet
Timeouts: the tasks' own (agent 1800-3600 s, stated in v3 instructions).
Relaunch rule: once, single task, only for a clear infrastructure failure (image build failure, sandbox lost,
  platform error); failed record kept. A session timeout, budget cap hit, or broken pipeline is the agent's result.
Hang rule: if a run is still active well past timeouts (> 30 min beyond the task's agent timeout + 20 min
  evaluation, with no progress), stop it with `valkyrie run stop` and report.

Gap rule operationalisation (DESIGN.md), fixed now, before any result:
- Per-case families (reg_resect, seg_spleen, measure_hc18): S = hidden cases the specialist is clinically
  acceptable on, from the same grading's specialist values. On S, an agent case that is invalid, late, or missing
  counts as a fail with quality 0. Paired differences agent - specialist with
  suite.core.metrics.paired_bootstrap_difference(np.mean, ...), 2000 resamples, seed 20261114, 95% percentile
  interval, for (a) per-case clinical acceptability (0/1) [verdict], (b) per-case quality [secondary], and
  (c) raw error in physical units on cases where the agent output is valid [secondary].
  Verdict: "gap shown" if the agent fails >=1 case in S and the upper bound of (a) < 0;
  "no gap" if the interval for (a) includes 0 (including the agent passing all of S) -- reported as
  "no gap shown" with the number of S failures when the agent fails any case of S;
  "not interpretable" for an infrastructure failure, a grading error, or evidence that our bug decided the result.
  A delivery failure (no runnable pipeline) is a gap by this rule but is labelled "delivery failure, not an
  accuracy gap".
- Cohort families (ecg_ptbxl, risk_icu): gap shown if the specialist meets every gate part and the agent misses at
  least one; no gap (control) if both meet every part; not interpretable if the specialist misses a part or
  grading failed. Gate parts reported individually.
- Session timeout: v3 instructions state the limit and the "graded as found" rule, so a timeout is the agent's
  result (unlike batch 1), unless the trace shows our bug.
- Raw values come from grader output (verifier stdout / metrics.json, or a local regrade of the carried pipeline
  with the task's own tests/grade.py, labelled as such), never from the 0-1 quality column.
- This batch is not pooled with batch 1 (v1 instructions) or pilot 1 (local).
